decisions.reason: Setting Danish as the templates' default language does not change bullet dimensions, balance, alignment, or scaling.
The default-language setting does not alter the requirement that pasted content remain within column and page boundaries.
The Danish default-language decision does not modify the specified legacy sources, migration target, or copy-paste stability behavior.
Numbered-list alignment and usability remain required unchanged regardless of the templates' default language.
The language configuration does not change the required ability to insert manual line breaks after pasted content.
The Danish default-language decision does not change the PBU style-name prefix, applicability condition, or covered style categories.
The new style system must still be applied consistently to all templates; the source does not change its specification or coverage.
Default-language configuration does not resolve or modify the table-layout and right-column-boundary requirements.
The Danish default-language setting does not change Tab-based level transitions, hierarchy structure, or nested-list alignment.
The templates remain targeted at modern Microsoft Word on Windows; selecting Danish as the default language does not change the supported environment or reliability requirement.
